_doc: ARC §1.3/§1.4/§3.4 render: heart poses near (lookUp fear, fist/curse, hurl with pebbles in flight, celebrate) on the §6.7 stub signs over the lookdev village's people. 888x500. Run: setsid nohup _harness/slot.sh node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/arc-work/specs/render-hearts.json --port=5312 > _harness/scratch/arc/render/shots-hearts.log 2>&1 &

shots.name: arc-pose-fear
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = false;
const p = G.poi('village'); window.__p = p; G.arc.stub('hearts', { signs: 3 }); await G.frames(8);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 34, tilt: 74, yaw: p.heading, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(10); F.advance(1); await G.frames(4);

shots.name: arc-pose-fist
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = window.__p; G.arc.stub('hearts', { signs: 2 }); await G.frames(8);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 34, tilt: 74, yaw: p.heading, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(10); F.advance(1); await G.frames(4);

shots.name: arc-pose-hurl
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = window.__p; G.arc.stub('hearts', { signs: 5 }); await G.frames(8);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 60, tilt: 70, yaw: p.heading, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(6);
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { F.advance(0.35); await G.frames(1); }
